name: Voznesenskoye GRS-Malmyzh GOK Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: length: no sourced length found; Gazprom inter-settlement line from GRS Voznesenskoye to Malmyzh GOK (Nanai district, Khabarovsk Krai), construction began 2024-08. Sponsor and endpoints and concrete step met, but length rule (>=25 km sourced) not satisfied. Region program lists 13 inter-settlement lines totalling 184 km (avg ~14 km), so likely under 25 km.
researcher_notes: Not a match to any existing GEM row (checked P0758, P2027, P5521 etc; none Voznesenskoye/Malmyzh). Sources eastrussia.ru and madviz.ru (Aug 2024) verified to load and name Malmyzh GOK but state no length; searches of ruscable, vnedra, nedradv, vostok.today, interfax-russia also gave no length. Revisit if a length >=25 km is sourced.
